title: fix(stats): prioritize health dashboard refresh
body:
## What

Prioritize the health-dashboard refresh in `.agents/scripts/stats-wrapper.sh` so a slow daily quality sweep cannot consume the scheduler ceiling before the dashboard update runs.

## Why

The originating dashboard alert is tracked at marcusquinn/quickfile-mcp#122. Its investigation observed `STATS-TIMEOUT` and `HEALTH-DASHBOARD-FAIL exit=124` after the synchronous quality sweep prevented an update.

## Files

- `.agents/scripts/stats-wrapper.sh`
- `.agents/scripts/tests/test-stats-wrapper-headless-export.sh`

## Implementation

Run `_stats_wrapper_run_health_update` before `run_daily_quality_sweep`, preserving non-zero dashboard failures and the existing non-fatal quality-sweep failure diagnostic.

## Verification

```bash
shellcheck .agents/scripts/stats-wrapper.sh .agents/scripts/tests/test-stats-wrapper-headless-export.sh
bash .agents/scripts/tests/test-stats-wrapper-headless-export.sh
bash .agents/scripts/tests/test-stats-wrapper-timeout.sh
bash .agents/scripts/stats-wrapper.sh --self-check
bash .agents/scripts/stats-wrapper.sh --dry-run
```

## Cross-repository context

For marcusquinn/quickfile-mcp#122.
